title: RxJS Quick Guide
description: Find a short explanation and a worked example for each idea in the RxJS course.

entries.name: Listen to a small stream
entries.summary: An observable sends values to a subscriber.

entries.name: Transform each value
entries.summary: map changes each emitted value into a new value.

entries.name: Keep values that pass a rule
entries.summary: filter allows values through only when its test is true.

entries.name: Take only a few values
entries.summary: take limits how many values a subscriber receives.

entries.name: Watch a timed stream
entries.summary: interval emits a growing count at a chosen time gap.

entries.name: Turn clicks into a stream
entries.summary: fromEvent listens to events from a target.

entries.name: Stop listening when finished
entries.summary: A subscription has an unsubscribe method.

entries.name: Send values with a Subject
entries.summary: A Subject is both something you can subscribe to and something you can send values into.

entries.name: Keep the latest value
entries.summary: A BehaviorSubject starts with one value and gives the latest value to each new subscriber.

entries.name: Combine the latest values
entries.summary: combineLatest waits until each input has a value, then emits their latest values together when either changes.

entries.name: Keep only the latest waiting job
entries.summary: switchMap switches to a new inner stream and unsubscribes from the previous one.

entries.name: Handle a stream error
entries.summary: catchError can replace a failed stream with another observable.
